about: AC Milan is one of Europe's most successful football clubs, based in Milan, Italy, with seven European Cup and Champions League titles and 19 Serie A championships. It plays at the San Siro stadium, shared with Inter. Revenue, roughly 400 million euros a year, comes from broadcasting, commercial sponsorship and matchday sales. Sponsors include Emirates on the shirt and Puma as kit supplier. RedBird Capital Partners, led by Gerry Cardinale, bought the club from Elliott Management in 2022. Global fan base of hundreds of millions, and a long record of partnerships with major brands.

wiki.title: AC Milan
wiki.text: Associazione Calcio Milan (Italian pronunciation: [assotʃatˈtsjoːne ˈkaltʃo ˈmiːlan]), commonly referred to as simply Milan (Italian pronunciation: [ˈmiːlan]) in Italy or AC Milan outside of Italy, is an Italian professional football club based in Milan, Lombardy. Founded in 1899, the club competes in Serie A, the top tier of Italian football. In its early history, Milan played its home games in different grounds around the city before moving to its current stadium, the San Siro, in 1926. The stadium, which was built by Milan's second chairman, Piero Pirelli, and has been shared with Inter Milan since 1947, is the largest in Italian football,

about: English Premier League football club based in north London, playing at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, a 62,000-seat venue that also hosts NFL games and concerts. Revenue comes from broadcasting, matchday, commercial sponsorship (partners include AIA, Nike and Kia) and stadium events. The club is controlled by ENIC Group, led by Daniel Levy, and has a global fan base of hundreds of millions of followers. One of the best known football brands worldwide, with a very strong sponsorship platform.

wiki.title: Tottenham Hotspur F.C.
wiki.text: Tottenham Hotspur Football Club, commonly referred to as simply Tottenham ( TOT-ən-əm) or Spurs, is a professional football club based in Tottenham, North London, England. They compete in the Premier League, the top tier of English football. Since 2019, the team have played their home matches in the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. It was built on the same site as their previous home, White Hart Lane, which was demolished. Founded in 1882, Tottenham Hotspur's emblem is a cockerel standing upon a football, with the Latin motto Audere est Facere ("to dare is to do"). The team have traditionally worn white shirts and navy blue shorts as their home kit

wiki.title: Clearwater Analytics
wiki.text: Clearwater Analytics Holdings, Inc. is an American software-as-a-service (SaaS) fintech company that provides automated investment accounting, performance, compliance, and risk reporting worldwide. Clearwater is headquartered in Boise, Idaho, with additional offices in London, Edinburgh, New York City and Noida.

about: Legence is a San Jose-based engineering and building-systems company providing mechanical, electrical, plumbing and energy efficiency services to commercial customers, per the input. Funding of about $2.8 billion is shown, probably including its 2025 IPO. B2B with no consumer awareness. Customers include data centres, hospitals and universities. The input lists consulting and energy efficiency, and the funding of $2.8 billion likely includes its recent listing and debt.

Paychex is a Rochester, New York company listed on Nasdaq (PAYX) that offers payroll, human resources, benefits and insurance services to small and mid-sized US businesses, serving about 740,000 clients. It earns recurring service fees and interest on client funds, with annual revenue above $5 billion, and bought Paycor in 2025. It also has strong visibility in US sport as a NASCAR and IndyCar sponsor, so it has a record of sponsorship activity.

wiki.title: Paychex
wiki.text: Paychex, Inc. is an American company that provides human resources, payroll, and employee benefits outsourcing services for small- to medium-sized businesses. Founded in 1971 and headquartered in Rochester, New York, the company has more than 100 offices serving approximately 800,000 payroll clients in the U.S. and Europe. Paychex is ranked 681st on the Fortune 500 list of largest corporations by revenue.

about: Trucordia is a US insurance brokerage based in Lindon, Utah, formed through the combination of several regional brokerages and backed by private equity investors, with Crunchbase showing about $5.5 billion in funding including equity and debt. It sells commercial insurance, employee benefits and personal lines, earning commissions and fees from carriers and clients. It grows by acquiring local agencies. B2B and local-agency focused, with limited national brand awareness.

about: US professional employer organisation based in Chandler, Arizona, that provides payroll, benefits, insurance and HR outsourcing to small and mid-sized businesses. Private and growing through acquisitions of other PEOs. B2B service with low public awareness.

ABM Industries is a New York-based facility services company providing janitorial, electrical, HVAC, parking, engineering and energy services to commercial, aviation, education and technology clients across the US, with about 100,000 employees and revenue near $8 billion. Founded in 1909. Listed on the NYSE (ABM). B2B services, moderate business recognition and stadium service presence.

Baker Tilly is a Chicago-based top-ten US accounting, tax, advisory and consulting firm, which combined with Moss Adams in 2025 to form a firm with roughly 10,000 staff and more than 3 billion dollars in revenue. Privately held and backed by Valeas Capital Partners. Customers are mid-market businesses, governments and nonprofits. B2B professional services brand, active in sports sponsorship in some markets.

Everforth is a US technology and digital engineering company based in Glen Allen, Virginia. Crunchbase classes it under consulting and information technology and describes it as a technology and digital engineering firm. It likely sells IT and engineering services to business customers, but the input does not support specifics on customers, scale or ownership. Little public brand awareness is indicated. about: HR Path is a French human resources consulting and software company founded in 2001 in Paris. It helps large employers implement and run HR information systems, such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday and Oracle, and offers payroll, HR outsourcing and consulting services. It operates across Europe, North America, Asia and Latin America with several thousand staff. It is privately owned with private equity backing. B2B services firm with limited public brand awareness.

about: Atos is a French multinational IT services and digital transformation company, offering consulting, cybersecurity, cloud, managed infrastructure, data centre and big data and supercomputing (Eviden) solutions to enterprises and governments. Headquartered in Bezons near Paris, with around 100,000 employees and revenue of roughly 10 billion euros. Listed on Euronext Paris (ATO). Atos went through a major financial restructuring in 2024 and has been selling units. It has long been a major IT partner of the Olympic and Paralympic Games. Mostly B2B brand with sports-partnership experience.

wiki.title: Atos
wiki.text: Atos SE is a European multinational information technology (IT) service and consulting company with headquarters in Bezons suburb of Paris, France, and offices worldwide. It specialises in hi-tech transactional services, unified communications, cloud, big data and cybersecurity services. Atos operates worldwide under the brands Atos, Syntel, and Eviden.

about: HKC Corporation is a Chinese manufacturer of liquid crystal display panels and monitors for televisions, notebooks, tablets and smartphones, with large fab facilities in Chongqing, Changsha, Mianyang and other locations, plus its own HKC-branded consumer monitors. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It sells to global brand customers such as TV and PC makers and to consumers via monitors in China and abroad. It pursued a listing in Shenzhen. Scale is large in panels, but the HKC brand is mainly known in gaming monitors.

about: Douzone Bizon is a Seoul-based South Korean business software company, listed on KOSDAQ, offering ERP, accounting, tax, groupware and cloud-based services for small and mid-sized businesses and large enterprises, including the Amaranth and iCUBE products. It earns subscription and licence revenue, with funding of about 1.4 trillion Korean won shown in Crunchbase. B2B software brand in South Korea, with little recognition outside the country.

Ayvens is a Rueil-Malmaison, France-based vehicle leasing and fleet management company, formed in 2023 by the merger of ALD Automotive and LeasePlan, and majority owned by Societe Generale. It leases and manages roughly 3 million vehicles in over 40 countries for corporate fleets, SMEs and individuals, and also offers flexible subscription services and used car sales. Listed on Euronext Paris (AYV). Revenue and its fleet size are among the largest in the world. B2B-led brand with growing consumer subscription visibility.

wiki.text: Ayvens, formerly ALD Automotive, is a French fleet managing and operational car leasing company and a majority owned subsidiary of Société Générale. The company is active internationally and manages around 3.42 million vehicles. about: STX Group is an Amsterdam based company that delivers environmental commodities and carbon credit solutions, trading and developing carbon credits, renewable energy certificates and nature-based projects for corporate buyers. It was previously part of a larger group and has operations in several countries. Ownership and scale are not confirmed here. B2B with no consumer brand. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Lightstorm is a Singapore-based telecom infrastructure company that builds and operates subsea cable systems and fibre networks across Asia, including the Bay of Bengal Gateway cable, and sells capacity, cloud-connectivity and managed network services to carriers, content providers and enterprises. It is a relatively new company, with recorded funding of about 32 billion in an Asian currency shown without a clear symbol. B2B telecom brand with no consumer profile. Ownership details are not confirmed here.

South-eastern European food and retail group formed in 2019 from the restructured Agrokor after its 2017 collapse. Operates supermarket chains such as Konzum in Croatia, Mercator in Slovenia and Roda, plus food production, agriculture and trading businesses, with tens of thousands of employees and revenue of several billion euros. Based in Zagreb. Ownership has been complicated by sanctions on Russian shareholders, including Sberbank. Funding of about EUR 550 million shown for July 2025. Strong consumer retail brands in the Balkans.

Egis is a French engineering, consulting and project operation group, based in Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines, working on roads, rail, airports, urban transport, water and buildings in more than 100 countries. It also operates airports and toll roads through concessions and runs mobility services. Revenue is around EUR 1.5-2 billion with about 19,000 employees. Shareholders include Caisse des Depots and employees. B2B infrastructure group with strong profile in public works circles.

Valsoft is a Canadian software holding company, based in Montreal's Saint-Laurent borough, that acquires and holds vertical market software companies for the long term, operating them in a decentralised way. Customers are the small and mid-sized businesses served by those software firms across sectors. Founded around 2015 and funded by private capital. Crunchbase shows $420 million in funding by December 2024. B2B investor, no consumer brand profile.

about: Andersen Tax is a Chicago-headquartered professional services firm offering tax, valuation, transaction advisory, global mobility and wealth planning services to companies, executives and high-net-worth individuals. It is a US-based successor to the tax practice of the former Arthur Andersen, formed in 2002, and operates in dozens of US offices and with global alliance firms. In 2026 data shows funding of about $189M, probably private equity-style growth capital. B2B advisory brand with little consumer awareness, though it has used sports sponsorship for client entertainment.

CSG International (CSG Systems) is a US software and services company based in Englewood, Colorado, listed on Nasdaq (CSGS). It provides billing, customer experience, monetisation and digital payments software, largely SaaS, to telecom operators, cable and media companies, plus businesses in other industries, including Charter and Comcast as big customers. Revenue is about 1.2 billion dollars. B2B technology brand with little public awareness, though large communications clients.

about: Jersey-headquartered fund, corporate and private client administration group providing services to private equity, real estate and debt funds, corporates and wealthy families in jurisdictions such as Jersey, Guernsey, Luxembourg, Ireland, the Cayman Islands and the US. Founded in 1987 and listed on the London Stock Exchange (JTC), it was subject to a takeover by Permira in 2025. Revenue comes from fees on assets and services, with thousands of staff. B2B with low consumer awareness but a strong reputation in fund administration.
